DEFAULT_PRODUCTION.description: Scans application source, server code, API routes, agent/tool/RAG code, config. Excludes tests, docs, examples, generated, vendor. VULNERABILITY findings from non-production paths are included.

EXTENDED_SECURITY.description: Scans everything except always-excluded. No non-production filtering.

accountingFields.filesAnalyzed: From Semgrep paths.scanned — files actually analyzed by Semgrep
accountingFields.filesWithFindings: Unique files with at least one finding (derived)
accountingFields.filesSkippedByEngine: Files Semgrep could not parse (parse errors)
accountingFields.findingsExcludedByReportingScope: Findings from non-production paths filtered out by scope mode

notReported: filesTargeted — Semgrep doesn't reliably report this
filesIntentionallyExcluded — would require knowing what would have been scanned
filesUnscannedDueToError — Semgrep doesn't separate this from parse errors
